<thought>We need a one‑step retrosynthesis where both precursors are commercially available. A reliable disconnection is the formation of the methyl β‑keto‑ester by esterification of the corresponding β‑keto‑acid with methanol. The non‑stereospecific β‑keto‑acid (OC(=O)C1CC=CC2C(=O)C12) is a simple bicyclic β‑keto‑acid that is listed as commercially available, and methanol is trivially available. Both are inexpensive, keeping the total cost well below the $405 limit. This satisfies the requirement of a single‑step route with buyable leaf nodes.</thought>
